blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Gilas Pilipinas coach Tim Cone acknowledged that it was not able to field the best team possible for its defense of the Asian Games gold that ended on a horrific note by missing a spot in the quarterfinals. Cone and the Philippines’ bid to repeat their dream run three years ago ended on Monday with a 105-61 defeat at the hands of China, not only failing to win but also avoiding a loss of 38 points or more which would have been enough for them to get out of the group stage.
